description: Get the documents linked to ONE entity (transaction, invoice, bill, estimate, contact, project, expense claim), or the entities linked to ONE document. Every call needs either document_id, or entity_type together with entity_id: there is no "list all links" call, and a call with neither returns nothing but an error. Look the id up first (get_transactions, get_invoices, search_documents), then call once per id. Use when user asks "what documents are attached to this invoice?" or "show me what's linked to that receipt".

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

document_id.description: Document ID to get links for

entity_id.description: Entity ID to get linked documents for

entity_type.description: Entity type: transaction, invoice, bill, estimate, contact, project, expense_claim

name: get_document_links
title: Get Document Links
